target: Update docs and help text to reflect merged claude_code tp-series support and routing readiness.

pr.title: Update Claude routing documentation
pr.body: Updates docs/specs and help text to reflect that claude_code is now implemented for tp-series execution and available in routing readiness evidence, while route/orchestrate and dope-agent-system integration remain deferred.

steps.task: Inspect the routing readiness artifacts and find stale docs/specs/help text.
requirements: Read out/verification/TP-DT-CLAUDE-ROUTING-READINESS-0001/VALIDATION.json, PROOF.json, DOCS_REVIEW.json, ROUTE_PLAN_RESULT.json, ROUTE_HANDOFF_RESULT.json, ROUTER_SOURCE_REVIEW.json, and AVAILABILITY_TEMPLATE_REVIEW.json if present.
Use the readiness artifacts as the primary source for what is stale.

Search README.md, docs, and CLI help text for stale phrases like 'gemini or codex', 'claude_code not implemented', 'ValueError for claude_code', 'route/orchestrate required for Claude', or pre-adapter-only state.
Classify stale items as docs-only, help-text-only, or behavior change required.
If any required change is behavior-changing, stop and report SCOPE_ESCALATION_REQUIRED.
validation:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('out/verification/TP-DT-CLAUDE-ROUTING-READINESS-0001')
assert base.exists(), f'missing readiness artifacts: {base}'
print('routing readiness artifacts present')
PY

steps.task: Update stale docs/specs and help text to match the current accepted Claude routing state.
requirements: Document that claude_code is implemented for tp-series execution.
Document that the real workflow is dopetask tp series exec --agent claude_code <packet.json>.
Document that routing readiness proved claude_code in availability template, generated availability.yaml, route plan, and handoff/report.
Document that route/orchestrate runner support is still deferred and separate.
Document that dope-agent-system integration is deferred and not runtime authority.
Document that no --bare default is allowed.
Update stale help text only if it is text-only and does not alter behavior.
Do not claim dope-agent-system integration exists.
Do not claim route/orchestrate Claude runner is implemented.
Do not remove historical caveats unless superseded by evidence.
validation: rg -n "claude_code|Claude Code|gemini or codex|not yet fully implemented|route/orchestrate|runners/claude_code|dope-agent-system" README.md docs src/dopetask/ops src/dopetask/cli.py || true

steps.task: Run validation, write proof, and commit.
requirements: Run compileall even if only docs changed, because help text may have changed.
Run focused CLI tests if help text changed.
Run full pytest --no-cov.
Write implementation proof JSON with stale docs found, files updated, validations, allowlist, and forbidden scope.
Commit only if validation passes and changed files are within allowlist.
Backfill proof metadata in a second commit if committed proof cannot self-reference.
